name: Defending the Dead
summary: At Gloomrise, spiders threaten Mulgore’s people and an ancient tauren burial ground. You are asked to help contain the infestation.

sections.title: The Burial Ground
sections.body: A camp asks you to protect Gloomrise, an ancient tauren burial ground northwest of the camp. Vicious spiders infest the site, threatening Mulgore’s people and damaging a place many tauren hold sacred.

sections.title: A Foothold
sections.body: Your efforts help the people of Mulgore establish a foothold against the spiders. Clearing the infestation completely may take time, so the burial ground remains at risk.

faq.answer: Gloomrise is an ancient tauren burial ground northwest of the camp.
Vicious spiders infest Gloomrise, threatening Mulgore’s people and damaging the sacred burial ground.

faq.q: Why is the burial ground sacred?

faq.answer: A camp asks you to help protect Gloomrise from its spider infestation.
No. Your efforts create a foothold, but clearing the infestation completely may take time.

angles.text: As a tauren, Gloomrise matters as an ancient burial ground that many of your people hold sacred.
